segments.text: Neither Prayer, nor any other part of religious Worship, is now under the Gospel either tyed unto, or made more acceptable by any place, in which it is performed, or towards which it is directed; but God is to be worshipped every where in spirit and in truth, as in private families dayly, and in secret each one by himself, so more solemnly in the publique assemblies, which are not carelesly nor wilfully to be neglected, or forsaken, when God by his Word of Providence calleth thereunto.
